products.name: Pathfinder Hemp & Root Limited Edition, 700ml
products.description: The Pathfinder is fermented from hemp and carefully refined by copper pot distillation. It is then blended with an alchemy of wormwood, angelic root, ginger, sage, juniper, saffron, orange peel, wild-crafted Douglas-fir and natural terpenes to yield this revolutionary spirit of both complexity and character. The Pathfinder tastes like an amaro, that fine class of European liquors known for bittersweet flavors rounded out by citrus and spice, and can be used as a flavorful substitute for amaro, whiskey, or vermouth. This miraculous elixir, like the hemp plant itself, has no pyschoactive effects, yet contains enough vitamin E, antioxidants, and other nutrients, to go favorably hand-in-hand with a balanced diet. And since there's no alcohol in The Pathfinder, it won't give you a hangover, either!

products.name: Roots Divino Bianco N/A Vermouth
products.description: Roots Divino are non-alcoholic aperitifs based on wine (di vino). The halo shape on the label symbolizes the divine effect of enjoying a drinking occasion without the alcohol. They're Bianco uses rosemary, thyme & wormwood, making it perfect to enjoy over ice with a lemon slice & tonic for a refreshing non-alcoholic spritz!

products.name: Roots Divino Rosso N/A Vermouth
products.description: Roots Divino are non-alcoholic aperitifs based on wine (di vino). The halo shape on the label symbolizes the divine effect of enjoying a drinking occasion without the alcohol. products.name: St. Agrestis Amaro Falso, 2x200ml
products.tagline: The Amaro for when you're not Amaro-ing!
products.description: Made by hand at their distillery in Brooklyn, NY using old world methods, St. Agrestis aims to create naturally colored, perfectly balanced and incredibly flavorful spirits while reinventing the way you drink some of the world’s most iconic spirits and cocktails. Created as the non-alcoholic counterpart to the beloved St. Agrestis Amaro, Amaro Falso is made using the same combination of all-natural citrus, botanical, and herbal ingredients found in their spiritous version, sans alcohol. Ready-to-drink and individually portioned, Amaro Falso is similar to an Amaro Highball, driven by nuanced notes of herbal spice, mint and bitter complexity from gentian root. The result is a refreshing beverage that makes it an ideal cocktail that fans of Italian aperitivi and digestivi expect. Lastly, carbonation and nitrogen have been added to help mimic the bite and mouth feel that alcohol typically provides. Enjoy chilled straight from the bottle or over ice with an orange twist.

products.name: St. Agrestis Mezcal Negroni, 2x200ml
products.tagline: The Negroni for when you're not Negroni-ing!
products.description: Made by hand at their distillery in Brooklyn, NY using old world methods, St. Agrestis aims to create naturally colored, perfectly balanced and incredibly flavorful spirits while reinventing the way you drink some of the world’s most iconic spirits and cocktails. Made with many of the same botanicals found in their beloved favorite, Phony Mezcal Negroni emphasizes mezcal qualities by offering nuanced notes of smoke, vegetal complexity and earthiness to compliment its bitter foundation. Gentle carbonation is added to help mimic the bite and mouth feel that alcohol typically provides. Enjoy chilled straight from the bottle or over ice with an orange twist.

products.name: St. Agrestis Phony Negroni, 2x200ml
products.tagline: The Negroni for when you're not Negroni-ing!
products.description: Made by hand at their distillery in Brooklyn, NY using old world methods, St. Agrestis aims to create naturally colored, perfectly balanced and incredibly flavorful spirits while reinventing the way you drink some of the world’s most iconic spirits and cocktails. This is your non-alcoholic classic Negroni. It has nuanced juniper, citrus, and floral notes and drinks with the same bitterness drinkers of the classic cocktail expect, sans alcohol. They've also added carbonation to help mimic the bite that alcohol typically provides. Enjoy chilled straight from the bottle or over ice with an orange twist. Or for a bubbly, low ABV option, top with Prosecco for a Negroni Sbagliato.

products.name: San Pellegrino Sanbitter, 10pc - 100ml
products.description: This famous Italian soda has a flavor similar to Campari, without the alcohol. Lightly sweetened and carbonated, it is great to pour over ice, garnish with a twist of lemon, or use as a mixer with bourbon or gin. When finished, don't throw the bottle away - they make great bud vases!

products.name: Crodino 6pk
products.description: An Italian classic since 1965! The perfect N/A apertivo to enjoy when the sun is setting, you have a few cheeses & small bites and you want to quite literally, chill. To enjoy the intense citrus/fruity notes and the pleasant bitter finish, serve Crodino in a wine glass with a generous helping of ice. Garnish with a slice of orange and you're set!

products.name: Lurisia Chinotto, 4pk
products.description: The unique aroma of our Chinotto comes from the west side of the Liguria Riviera where, since 1500, Chinotto trees have grown. There is now a Slow Food Presidium to protect the precious citrus fruits that give this drink it's characteristic amber color and scent of citrus & spices. Not too sweet, it is perfect enjoyed right from the bottle or as a mixer when you want some extra punch!

products.name: Casamara Club Alta, 4pk
products.tagline: N/A soda reminiscent of classic Italian aperitivos!
products.description: The 2 founders at Casamara Club think it should be easier for you (and your guests) to enjoy a really good drink without the alcohol. Accordingly, all their recipes are minimally processed with carefully sourced ingredients. The result is a lineup of delicious & refreshing drinks that are far less sweet than others on the market. Perfect for drinking all day! Alta is an Italian style botanical soda with classic aperitivo aromatics and an extra dry finish. It has a pleasant pink citrus bite, and warm, fruity spice notes, reminiscent of a Negroni.

products.name: Casamara Club Como, 4pk
products.tagline: N/A soda reminiscent of alpine aperitivos!
products.description: The 2 founders at Casamara Club think it should be easier for you (and your guests) to enjoy a really good drink without the alcohol. products.name: Casamara Club Super Clasico N/A Apertivo
products.tagline: N/A soda reminiscent of sitting in a Milan cafe at 6pm!
products.description: Super Clasico is a bittersweet, sunset-hued aperitivo built like a proper libation with full cocktail-strength. Each botanical is extracted separately before blending. Italian chinotto, a bitter citrus grown along the Calabrian coast, opens bright and sharp alongside juniper. Orris root harvested from the roots of the iris flower provides a grounding, earthy bass note. Tart red currant lends acidity, not sweetness. Kola nut and allspice develop tannin structure. Bourbon-grade Madagascar vanilla rounds the finish. It tastes like sitting at a Milan cafe at 6pm as the city shifts gears!

products.name: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co. Extra Bitter Tonic, 8oz
products.description: The Jack Rudy Cocktail Company is a family-run company based in Charleston, S.C., and Lexington, KY. They take long-forgotten staples of the American bar and reinvent them so we can enjoy cocktails from the golden age, as our grandparents might have. The small company got a huge boost when the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, GQ, and others praised their debut product Small Batch Tonic. They’ve since added many great products. Their Extra Bitter Tonic has an added bitterness for those that like a fuller, drier gin and tonic. It pairs nicely with a classic, juniper-forward gin

These Oregon cherries are soaked in bourbon, and are the perfect addition to any cocktail that uses whiskey. Don't feel like a cocktail? No problem. They are just as good enjoyed right out of the jar!

products.name: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co. Vermouth Brined Olives, 16oz
products.description: The Jack Rudy Cocktail Company is a family-run company based in Charleston, S.C., and Lexington, KY. They take long-forgotten staples of the American bar and reinvent them so we can enjoy cocktails from the golden age, as our grandparents might have. The small company got a huge boost when the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, GQ, and others praised their debut product Small Batch Tonic. They’ve since added many great products. Their Vermouth Brined Olives are premium cocktail olives in a brine of dry vermouth, juniper and coriander. The hearty olives are designed for classic cocktails and bloody mary’s. The flavorful brine also makes the best dirty martinis.

products.name: Jack Rudy Tonic Syrup, 17oz
products.description: Jack Rudy's Classic Tonic Syrup (formerly known as our Small Batch Tonic) is essentially a quinine concentrate. It’s designed to pair with your favorite Gin or Vodka, and is then stretched with soda water to make a bright, light, refreshing highball. With a backbone of quinine, culled from the Cinchona Tree, they've added a delicate mix of botanicals and then sweetened it with real cane sugar; the final product is a complex mixture that introduces a fine bitterness to any cocktail, and a great pairing with the botanicals of the finest Gins in the world.

products.name: Luxardo Maraschino Cherries, 400g
products.description: These cherries are the real deal. Produced the same way since 1905, they have no thickening agents or preservatives. Deep burgundy red in color, small, sweet and sour, they are a far cry from the electric red, processed maraschinos you found in your Shirley Temple as a kid. Without these cherries, no Manhattan is complete. Although ideal for cocktails, they are equally delicious right out of the jar, or spooned over ice cream and desserts.

products.name: Mexican Coke, 355ml
products.description: The real thing. Made with only pure cane sugar and served in a bottle. The way it was meant to be.

products.name: Orasella Maraschino Cocktail Cherries, 236g
products.description: Reclaiming the maraschino cherry and introducing modern drinkers to the traditional Italian recipe, free of preservatives, dyes, and other artificial ingredients. That’s the mission of the Seattle-based Orasella Maraschino Cherries. Made with local, Washington-grown cherries, the Evergreen State is the nation’s top cherry producer, Orasella Maraschino Cherries are harvested, prepared, and preserved by hand. Recognizable fruit flavored with pure maraschino liqueur. It’s that simple, that delicious.
